test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A type of piston which provides an even distribution of the air-fuel mixture, consistent flame front during combustion and it has the smallest surface area on top is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __Flat Piston**(Option 3)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Flat pistons__ are designed to provide an even distribution of the air-fuel mixture.
 
• They ensure a consistent flame front during combustion.
 
• Flat pistons have the smallest surface area on top, reducing heat loss.
 
• These pistons are commonly used in engines where efficiency and uniform combustion are a priority.
 
• Their design helps in lowering emissions and improving fuel economy.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Semi-Spherical Piston:**

 
 
• These pistons have a dome-shaped top to increase compression.
 
• They are often used in high-performance engines.
 
 
 
• **Dome Piston: **
 
 
• The dome shape increases the compression ratio but may cause uneven flame propagation.
 
• Used in engines requiring higher power output.
 
 
 
• **Dish Piston:**
 
 
• These pistons have a concave top to reduce compression.
 
• They are used in turbocharged or supercharged engines to prevent detonation.
